data.name: S_SentryTelemetry_Enabled_D
data.value: Upload crash, log, trace, and performance data; this does not control online status reporting

data.name: S_OnlineStatus_Mode_D
data.value: The client reports only the device identifier and device type, and the service derives location from the request address, so no IP or city is sent; choosing off disables online-status reporting entirely
